researchEvidence.note: The Division of Labor states its Licensing Section includes the Contractor Licensing Board, HVAC technician certification, manufactured housing, and plumbing supervision programs and issues or renews contractor, HVAC, housing, and plumber credentials.
The official database search page links contractor license search, current certified HVAC technicians, current certified plumbers, and other Division of Labor lists.

The Contractor Licensing Board bulletin lists exams and scope descriptions for general building, general engineering, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, residential, remodeling and repair, sprinklers, structural steel, and utilities contractors.
The Division of Labor states West Virginia law requires HVAC technician certification for heating, ventilating, and cooling system work, subject to listed exemptions.
The Division of Labor states West Virginia law requires plumber certification for plumbing work, subject to listed exemptions.
